# MRP Amendments All MRP amendments listed in the roleplay rules have been repeated here, in full, for ease of reference.
- [textlink="4. Do not metagame, do not metagrudge" link="RuleR4"]
Being in the critically injured state or otherwise unconscious (includes sleeping) prevents your character from remembering anything that happened to or around them while unconscious. If brought out of the critical state to the alive state, you may remember what caused you to enter critical state. Entering the dead state causes your character to forget all events related to their death (if you can tie it to how you died, do not remember it). If revived, placed in a MMI, or in the case of Diona, splitting, the character is aware of the fact that they have died but not how.
- [textlink="9. As an antagonist, do not cause excessive death, damage, or destruction beyond your objectives" link="RuleR9"]
As an antagonist, do not make the Emergency Shuttle uninhabitable or otherwise cause excessive death, damage, or destruction to the Emergency Shuttle.
- [textlink="11. Follow reasonable escalation" link="RuleR11"]
Escalation rules are enforced even against non-players.
- [textlink="13. Stick to your role" link="RuleR13"]
This is enforced more strictly on MRP.
